_about: Formula recognition (notes/formula-recognition/DESIGN.md, work/xvr, 2026-10-24): a custom formula read as a chain of catalog steps. The Inspector's line under the step names the steps it was read as, in one short clause with catalog names that carry no parameter letters (review frperf-5); a formula of several steps deforms along their homotopies in turn. id -> {en, ru, note}. Russian follows notes/i18n/GLOSSARY.md (естественный путь, гарантии, гомотопия, отрисовка). {chain} is a list of catalog labels (already translated) joined by ' → '. Read by tools/make_ru_table.py (v15-*.json).

rec.same.note: Inspector, the step's note line: the typed formula is this chain of catalog steps (it renders, deforms and reports as that chain). {chain}: labels joined by ' → '.

rec.partly.note: Inspector: only some parts are catalog steps; 'Custom formula' in the chain names the rest.

rec.scaling.note: A chain label for 'Multiply by c' without the letter c (GLOSSARY: rotation, scaling = поворот, растяжение).

rec.translation.note: A chain label for 'Translate by c' without the letter c.

rec.sqrt.note: A chain label for 'n-th root' with n = 2.

rec.root.note: A chain label for 'n-th root' with n > 2, without the letter n.

rec.hom.en: the homotopy that runs its %{n} catalog steps in turn, each on an equal part of $0\le t\le 1$ ($u_j$: the point after step $j$): %{list}
rec.hom.ru: гомотопия, которая по очереди выполняет шаги каталога, из которых составлена формула (всего %{n}), каждый на равной части отрезка $0\le t\le 1$ ($u_j$ — точка после шага $j$): %{list}
rec.hom.note: Deformation caption of a formula read as several catalog steps; %{list} is each step's own homotopy phrase, joined by '; then '.

rec.then.note: Joins the steps' homotopy phrases in rec.hom.
